# Faecal Microbiota Transplantation (FMT)

## What is the trend of the microbiota in each type after FMT?

### Alpha diversity

```{r alpha_div_plot_all, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=8, fig.fullwidth=TRUE}
label_map <- c(
  "Control" = "Cold-control", 
  "Treatment" = "Cold-intervention",
  "Hot_control" = "Warm-control",
  "richness" = "Species Richness",
  "neutral" = "Neutral Diversity",
  "phylogenetic" = "Phylogenetic Diversity"
)

alpha_div %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code)) %>%
  filter(time_point %in% c("FMT1","Acclimation", "FMT2")) %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("richness", "neutral", "phylogenetic"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = value, x = time_point, color = type, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.8), alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ type, scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(metric = label_map, type = label_map))+
#  facet_nested(.~metric+type, labeller = labeller(metric = label_map, type = label_map))+
  scale_color_manual(name="Type",
                       breaks=c("Cold_control", "Warm_control", "Cold_intervention"),
                       labels=c("Cold_control", "Warm_control", "Cold_intervention"),
                       values=c("#4477AA","#d57d2c","#76b183")) +
      scale_fill_manual(name="Type",
                       breaks=c("Cold_control", "Warm_control", "Cold_intervention"),
                       labels=c("Cold_control", "Warm_control", "Cold_intervention"),
                       values=c("#4477AA50","#d57d2c50","#76b18350")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=10))+
  labs(x = "Time Point", y = "value")
```

***Pairwise comparisons between time-points within each group***

Post-hoc contrasts of the neutral diversity model (Tukey-adjusted p-values), used for the brackets in Figure 3a of the manuscript.

```{r alpha_div_contrasts_within_type, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
emmeans::emmeans(Modelq1n, pairwise ~ time_point | type, adjust = "tukey")$contrasts
```

***Between-group contrasts at each time-point (Supplementary Table S8)***

Estimated marginal means of the neutral diversity model (`Modelq1n`), compared between groups within each time-point, with Tukey adjustment over the three contrasts of each time-point. Groups in the data are `Cold_control` (CC, Control in the figure script), `Cold_intervention` (CI, Treatment) and `Warm_control` (WC, Hot_control). The table reports first minus second group in the order CC, CI, WC (CC - WC, CI - WC, CI - CC), i.e. the sign of the CC - CI contrast returned by `pairs()` is reversed. The last row is the unadjusted contrast between cold-intervention at FMT2 and warm-control at acclimation.

```{r table_S8_alpha_between_groups, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
emm_type_time <- emmeans::emmeans(Modelq1n, ~ type | time_point)
table_S8 <- as.data.frame(pairs(emm_type_time, adjust = "tukey")) %>%
  mutate(flip = contrast == "Cold_control - Cold_intervention",
         estimate = ifelse(flip, -estimate, estimate),
         t.ratio = ifelse(flip, -t.ratio, t.ratio),
         contrast = recode(contrast,
                           "Cold_control - Warm_control" = "CC - WC",
                           "Cold_intervention - Warm_control" = "CI - WC",
                           "Cold_control - Cold_intervention" = "CI - CC")) %>%
  select(time_point, contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value) %>%
  arrange(factor(time_point, levels = c("Acclimation", "FMT1", "FMT2")),
          factor(contrast, levels = c("CC - WC", "CI - WC", "CI - CC")))

emm_all <- emmeans::emmeans(Modelq1n, ~ type * time_point)
emm_grid <- as.data.frame(emm_all)
w <- as.numeric(emm_grid$type == "Cold_intervention" & emm_grid$time_point == "FMT2") -
     as.numeric(emm_grid$type == "Warm_control" & emm_grid$time_point == "Acclimation")
last_row <- as.data.frame(emmeans::contrast(emm_all, list("CI(FMT2) - WC(Acclimation)" = w), adjust = "none")) %>%
  transmute(time_point = "FMT2 (CI) vs Acclimation (WC)", contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value)

bind_rows(table_S8, last_row) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, SE, t.ratio), ~ round(., 2)),
         p.value = signif(p.value, 3)) %>%
  tt()
```

***Repeated-measures tests (same individuals at Acclimation, FMT1 and FMT2)***

The legacy `adonis2(d ~ type*time_point, strata = individual)` calls below cannot test the between-individual `type` term and their within-individual permutations of raw data are anti-conservative for the interaction. The manuscript instead reports (i) the type x time_point interaction with a distance-based Freedman-Lane test (residuals of the reduced model `~ type + time_point` permuted within individual; the adonis2 R2 of the interaction is reported alongside) and (ii) the between-individual `type` effect with a whole-plot test (group labels permuted across individuals).

```{r repeated_measures_helpers, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
# Euclidean embedding of a distance matrix (all positive eigenvalues of the Gower-centred matrix)
fl_embed <- function(d) {
  pc <- suppressWarnings(cmdscale(d, k = attr(d, "Size") - 1, eig = TRUE))  # warning: non-Euclidean distances, negative eigenvalues dropped
  pc$points[, pc$eig[seq_len(ncol(pc$points))] > 1e-8, drop = FALSE]
}
# Residual sum of squares of Y after projecting on design X (QR based)
fl_rss <- function(Y, X) { q <- qr(X); sum(qr.resid(q, Y)^2) }

# (a) Distance-based Freedman-Lane test of the type x time_point interaction.
# d: dist; meta: data frame with Tube_code, type, time_point, individual (matched to labels(d) by Tube_code).
# Returns pseudo-F, partial R2 (SS_interaction / SS_total) and the permutation p value.
fl_interaction_test <- function(d, meta, nperm = 9999) {
  meta <- as.data.frame(meta)[match(labels(d), meta$Tube_code), ]
  meta$type <- factor(meta$type); meta$time_point <- factor(meta$time_point)
  Y <- fl_embed(d); n <- nrow(Y)
  X0 <- model.matrix(~ type + time_point, meta)
  X1 <- model.matrix(~ type * time_point, meta)
  Fstat <- function(Yp) {
    r0 <- fl_rss(Yp, X0); r1 <- fl_rss(Yp, X1)
    ((r0 - r1) / (ncol(X1) - ncol(X0))) / (r1 / (n - ncol(X1)))
  }
  q0 <- qr(X0); fit0 <- qr.fitted(q0, Y); res0 <- qr.resid(q0, Y)
  F_obs <- Fstat(Y)
  ss_tot <- sum(scale(Y, scale = FALSE)^2)
  R2 <- (fl_rss(Y, X0) - fl_rss(Y, X1)) / ss_tot
  set.seed(123)
  ctrl <- how(within = Within(type = "free"),
              plots = Plots(strata = factor(meta$individual), type = "none"), nperm = nperm)
  perms <- shuffleSet(n, nperm, control = ctrl)
  Fp <- apply(perms, 1, function(p) Fstat(fit0 + res0[p, , drop = FALSE]))
  tibble(test = "Freedman-Lane type x time_point (within-individual)", n = n,
         F = F_obs, R2_partial = R2, p = (1 + sum(Fp >= F_obs - 1e-12)) / (1 + nperm))
}

# (b) Whole-plot test of the between-individual `type` effect after time_point:
# individuals' group labels are permuted across individuals (each individual keeps its time points).
wholeplot_type_test <- function(d, meta, nperm = 9999) {
  meta <- as.data.frame(meta)[match(labels(d), meta$Tube_code), ]
  meta$type <- factor(meta$type); meta$time_point <- factor(meta$time_point)
  Y <- fl_embed(d); n <- nrow(Y)
  ind <- factor(meta$individual)
  ind_type <- meta$type[match(levels(ind), meta$individual)]
  Xt <- model.matrix(~ time_point, meta)
  Fty <- function(tp) {
    ty <- tp[as.integer(ind)]
    X1 <- cbind(Xt, model.matrix(~ ty)[, -1, drop = FALSE])
    r0 <- fl_rss(Y, Xt); r1 <- fl_rss(Y, X1)
    ((r0 - r1) / (ncol(X1) - ncol(Xt))) / (r1 / (n - ncol(X1)))
  }
  F_obs <- Fty(ind_type)
  set.seed(123)
  Fp <- replicate(nperm, Fty(sample(ind_type)))
  tibble(test = "Whole-plot type (after time_point)", n = n, n_individuals = nlevels(ind),
         F = F_obs, p = (1 + sum(Fp >= F_obs - 1e-12)) / (1 + nperm))
}
```

***Richness***
```{r beta_richness_permanova_post7_2_comparison, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
richness_post7 <- as.matrix(beta_q0n$S)
richness_post7 <- as.dist(richness_post7[rownames(richness_post7) %in% samples_to_keep_post7,
               colnames(richness_post7) %in% samples_to_keep_post7])
set.seed(123)
betadisper(richness_post7, subset_meta_post7$type[match(labels(richness_post7), subset_meta_post7$Tube_code)]) %>% permutest(., pairwise = TRUE, permutations = 9999)
```

```{r beta_richness_permanova_post7_1_comparison, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
# LEGACY (not reported): adonis2 with strata = individual cannot test the between-individual `type` term and is anti-conservative for the interaction.
# Use omnibus_group_by_time (Freedman-Lane interaction + whole-plot type test) below.
set.seed(123)
adonis2(richness_post7 ~ type*time_point,
        data = subset_meta_post7 %>% arrange(match(Tube_code,labels(richness_post7))),
        permutations = 9999,
        strata = subset_meta_post7 %>% arrange(match(Tube_code,labels(richness_post7))) %>% pull(individual),
        by="terms") %>%
        broom::tidy() %>%
        tt()
```

***Group x time (Freedman-Lane) and group (whole-plot) tests: reported in the manuscript***
```{r omnibus_group_by_time, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
omni_dist <- list(Richness = richness_post7, Neutral = neutral_post7, Phylogenetic = phylo_post7)
omni_meta <- subset_meta_post7
# adonis2 R2 of the interaction (legacy chunks above, same value; no strata needed for R2)
omni_res <- imap_dfr(omni_dist, function(d, m) {
  md <- omni_meta %>% arrange(match(Tube_code, labels(d)))
  a <- adonis2(d ~ type * time_point, data = md, permutations = 0, by = "terms")
  bind_rows(
    fl_interaction_test(d, omni_meta, nperm = 9999) %>%
      mutate(adonis2_R2_interaction = a$R2[3]),
    wholeplot_type_test(d, omni_meta, nperm = 9999)) %>%
    mutate(metric = m, .before = 1)
})
omni_res %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 4))) %>% tt()
```

               inherit.aes = FALSE, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = biplot_scores, aes(x = CAP1, y = CAP2, label = Variable),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.5)+
  theme_classic()

***Centroid trajectories (Figure 3b)***

Group centroids are the mean dbRDA site scores of each experimental group at each time-point. In the manuscript figure the centroids are numbered (1, Acclimation; 2, FMT1; 3, FMT2) and joined by curved arrows that show the trajectory of each group.

```{r dbrda_centroid_trajectories, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cca_neutral <- capscale(neutral_post7 ~ time_point * type,
                        data = subset_meta_post7 %>% arrange(match(Tube_code, labels(neutral_post7))))
vegan::scores(cca_neutral, display = "sites") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Tube_code") %>%
  left_join(subset_meta_post7, by = "Tube_code") %>%
  group_by(type, time_point) %>%
  summarise(CAP1 = mean(CAP1), CAP2 = mean(CAP2), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tt()
```

### Functional differences

### Paired functional-trait tests (same individuals)

```{r paired_trait_tests_acc_fmt1, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test per trait, pairing by individual (only individuals with both time points),
# same trait filtering as the unpaired chunks (samples with any non-zero trait, traits with sum > 0 within the group and time points),
# Benjamini-Hochberg across traits within each contrast.
# Unpaired counts (wilcox.test(value ~ time_point) + BH) are shown for comparison: exploratory, they treat samples as independent.
paired_trait_test <- function(ty, tp_a, tp_b) {
  long <- element_gift %>%
    filter(time_point %in% c(tp_a, tp_b) & type == ty) %>%
    select(-time_point, -type) %>%
    filter(rowSums(across(where(is.numeric), ~ . != 0)) > 0) %>%
    select(Tube_code, where(~ is.numeric(.) && sum(.) > 0)) %>%
    left_join(sample_metadata[c("Tube_code", "time_point", "individual")], by = "Tube_code") %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(Tube_code, time_point, individual), names_to = "trait", values_to = "value")
  pu <- long %>% group_by(trait) %>%
    summarise(p = wilcox.test(value ~ time_point)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, "BH"))
  w <- long %>% select(-Tube_code) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = time_point, values_from = value, values_fn = mean) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[tp_a]]), !is.na(.data[[tp_b]]))
  n_pairs <- n_distinct(w$individual)
  pp <- w %>% group_by(trait) %>%
    summarise(p = tryCatch(wilcox.test(.data[[tp_a]], .data[[tp_b]], paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
                           error = function(e) NA_real_), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, "BH"))
  tibble(contrast = paste0(c(Cold_control = "CC", Cold_intervention = "CI", Warm_control = "WC")[[ty]], ": ", tp_a, " vs ", tp_b),
         n_paired = n_pairs,
         n_sig_paired_BH = sum(pp$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
         min_p_paired = min(pp$p, na.rm = TRUE),
         min_p_adj_paired = min(pp$p_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
         min_attainable_exact_p = 2 / 2^n_pairs,
         n_sig_unpaired_BH_exploratory = sum(pu$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE))
}
paired_trait_results <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(c("Cold_control", "Cold_intervention", "Warm_control"), paired_trait_test, tp_a = "Acclimation", tp_b = "FMT1"),
  map_dfr(c("Cold_control", "Cold_intervention", "Warm_control"), paired_trait_test, tp_a = "FMT1", tp_b = "FMT2"))
paired_trait_results %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !c(n_paired, n_sig_paired_BH, n_sig_unpaired_BH_exploratory), ~ signif(., 3))) %>% tt()
```

***CI from acclimation to FMT1***

*Exploratory: the unpaired rank-sum tests and plots in this section treat samples as independent (see `paired_trait_tests_acc_fmt1` above for the paired tests).*

```{r comunity_elem_FMT3_cold_1, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
significant_element<-element_gift %>%
  filter(time_point %in% c("FMT1","Acclimation") & type == "Cold_intervention") %>%
  select(-time_point, -type) %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(where(is.numeric), ~ . != 0)) > 0) %>%
  select(Tube_code, where( ~ is.numeric(.) && sum(.) > 0)) %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata[c("Tube_code", "time_point")], by = "Tube_code") %>% 
  pivot_longer(-c(Tube_code, time_point),
               names_to = "trait",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(p_value = wilcox.test(value ~ time_point)$p.value) %>%
  mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  filter(p_adjust < 0.05) %>%
  remove_rownames() %>% 
  left_join(., uniqueGIFT_db, by=join_by("trait"=="Code_element"))
```

```{r comunity_elem_fm2_3, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
element_gift_sig <- element_gift %>%
  select(Tube_code, all_of(intersect(
    significant_element$trait,
    colnames(element_gift)
  ))) %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata[c("Tube_code", "type", "time_point")], by = join_by(Tube_code == Tube_code)) %>%
  filter(time_point %in% c("FMT1","Acclimation"))%>%
  filter(type=="Cold_intervention")
  
difference_table <- element_gift_sig %>%
  select(-Tube_code, -type) %>%
  group_by(time_point) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean)) %>%
  t() %>%
  row_to_names(row_number = 1) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate_if(is.character, as.numeric) %>%
  rownames_to_column(., "Elements") %>%
  left_join(.,uniqueGIFT_db[c(1,3,4)],by = join_by(Elements == Code_element)) %>% 
  arrange(Function) %>% 
  mutate(Difference=Acclimation-FMT1)%>% 
  mutate(group_color = ifelse(Difference <0,"FMT1", "Acclimation")) 
```

```{r commun_wilcox_elem_plot_fmt2_1, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=12, fig.fullwidth=TRUE}
difference_table %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=forcats::fct_reorder(Function,Difference), y=Difference, fill=group_color)) + 
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#76b183",'#008080')) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0) + 
  coord_flip()+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "right", 
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.15, linetype = 'solid',
                                        colour = "grey"))+
  xlab("Function") + 
  ylab("Mean difference")
```

***Supplementary Table S1: pairwise PERMANOVA between the three groups at FMT1***

All values of Supplementary Table S1, in the layout of the table (rows CI vs CC, CI vs WC, CC vs WC within each metric). `pairwise.adonis` with 99,999 permutations, `set.seed(123)` set in the chunks above; `p.adjusted` is the Bonferroni correction across the three pairs within each metric.

```{r table_S1_pairwise_fmt1, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
lab_pairs <- c("Cold_intervention vs Cold_control" = "CI vs CC",
               "Cold_control vs Cold_intervention" = "CI vs CC",
               "Cold_intervention vs Warm_control" = "CI vs WC",
               "Warm_control vs Cold_intervention" = "CI vs WC",
               "Cold_control vs Warm_control" = "CC vs WC",
               "Warm_control vs Cold_control" = "CC vs WC")
table_S1 <- bind_rows(
  Richness = pairwise_FMT1_richness,
  Neutral = pairwise_FMT1_neutral,
  Phylogenetic = pairwise_FMT1_phylo,
  .id = "Metric") %>%
  mutate(pairs = unname(lab_pairs[pairs]),
         pairs = factor(pairs, levels = c("CI vs CC", "CI vs WC", "CC vs WC"))) %>%
  arrange(factor(Metric, levels = c("Richness", "Neutral", "Phylogenetic")), pairs) %>%
  select(pairs, Metric, Df, SumsOfSqs, F.Model, R2, p.value, p.adjusted) %>%
  mutate(across(c(SumsOfSqs, F.Model, R2), ~ round(., 3)),
         across(c(p.value, p.adjusted), ~ ifelse(. < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", .))))
table_S1 %>%
  tt()
```

        data = subset_meta_FMT2 %>% arrange(match(Tube_code,labels(neutral_FMT2))),

        tt()

***Supplementary Table S2: pairwise PERMANOVA between the three groups at FMT2***

All values of Supplementary Table S2, in the layout of the table (rows CI vs CC, CI vs WC, CC vs WC within each metric). `pairwise.adonis` with 99,999 permutations, `set.seed(123)` set in the chunks above; `p.adjusted` is the Bonferroni correction across the three pairs within each metric.

```{r table_S2_pairwise_fmt2, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
lab_pairs <- c("Cold_intervention vs Cold_control" = "CI vs CC",
               "Cold_control vs Cold_intervention" = "CI vs CC",
               "Cold_intervention vs Warm_control" = "CI vs WC",
               "Warm_control vs Cold_intervention" = "CI vs WC",
               "Cold_control vs Warm_control" = "CC vs WC",
               "Warm_control vs Cold_control" = "CC vs WC")
table_S2 <- bind_rows(
  Richness = pairwise_FMT2_richness,
  Neutral = pairwise_FMT2_neutral,
  Phylogenetic = pairwise_FMT2_phylo,
  .id = "Metric") %>%
  mutate(pairs = unname(lab_pairs[pairs]),
         pairs = factor(pairs, levels = c("CI vs CC", "CI vs WC", "CC vs WC"))) %>%
  arrange(factor(Metric, levels = c("Richness", "Neutral", "Phylogenetic")), pairs) %>%
  select(pairs, Metric, Df, SumsOfSqs, F.Model, R2, p.value, p.adjusted) %>%
  mutate(across(c(SumsOfSqs, F.Model, R2), ~ round(., 3)),
         across(c(p.value, p.adjusted), ~ ifelse(. < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", .))))
table_S2 %>%
  tt()
```

***Is the cold-intervention group closer to the warm-control (donor) group than the cold-control group at FMT1?***

For each FMT1 sample of the cold-control and cold-intervention groups, the mean dissimilarity to all warm-control FMT1 samples is computed (neutral q = 1 dissimilarity, `beta_q1n$S`; richness `beta_q0n$S` and phylogenetic `beta_q1p$S` for completeness) and the two groups are compared with a Wilcoxon rank-sum test (normal approximation, `exact = FALSE`, because of ties/size).

```{r distance_to_warm_control_fmt1, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dist_to_wc <- function(S, tp = "FMT1") {
  D <- as.matrix(S)
  meta_tp <- sample_metadata %>% filter(time_point == tp, Tube_code %in% rownames(D))
  wc <- meta_tp %>% filter(type == "Warm_control") %>% pull(Tube_code)
  meta_tp %>%
    filter(type %in% c("Cold_control", "Cold_intervention")) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(mean_dist_to_WC = mean(D[Tube_code, wc])) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Tube_code, type, mean_dist_to_WC)
}
distance_tests_fmt1 <- list(Richness = beta_q0n$S, Neutral = beta_q1n$S, Phylogenetic = beta_q1p$S) %>%
  imap(function(S, metric) {
    d <- dist_to_wc(S)
    wt <- wilcox.test(mean_dist_to_WC ~ type, data = d, exact = FALSE)
    d %>% group_by(type) %>% summarise(n = n(), median = median(mean_dist_to_WC), mean = mean(mean_dist_to_WC), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = c(n, median, mean)) %>%
      mutate(Metric = metric, W = unname(wt$statistic), p_value = wt$p.value, .before = 1)
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()
distance_tests_fmt1 %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))) %>%
  tt()
```

***Mean dissimilarity between groups (neutral, q = 1)***

Mean of all between-sample neutral dissimilarities of each pair of groups at FMT1 and FMT2 (dbRDA centroids are given in chunk `dbrda_centroid_trajectories`). These values support the Discussion statements about the cold-intervention group moving towards, and then away from, the donor (warm-control) community.

```{r mean_between_group_dissimilarity, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
D_neutral <- as.matrix(beta_q1n$S)
between_group_dissimilarity <- function(tp, g1, g2) {
  a <- sample_metadata %>% filter(time_point == tp, type == g1, Tube_code %in% rownames(D_neutral)) %>% pull(Tube_code)
  b <- sample_metadata %>% filter(time_point == tp, type == g2, Tube_code %in% rownames(D_neutral)) %>% pull(Tube_code)
  tibble(time_point = tp, pair = paste(g1, "-", g2), n1 = length(a), n2 = length(b), mean_dissimilarity = mean(D_neutral[a, b]))
}
expand_grid(time_point = c("FMT1", "FMT2"),
            pair = list(c("Cold_intervention", "Warm_control"), c("Cold_intervention", "Cold_control"), c("Cold_control", "Warm_control"))) %>%
  pmap(function(time_point, pair) between_group_dissimilarity(time_point, pair[1], pair[2])) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(mean_dissimilarity = round(mean_dissimilarity, 3)) %>%
  tt()
```

***Dispersion tests (Supplementary Table S10 rows for FMT1, FMT2 and acclimation vs FMT1)***

Same tests as in `supplementary_tables/table_S10_dispersion.R` (betadisper + permutest, 9,999 permutations, `set.seed(123)` before each call), collected in one table: global F and p, and unadjusted pairwise permuted p-values for the three-group comparisons.

```{r dispersion_table_fmt, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
disp_metrics <- c(Richness = "beta_q0n", Neutral = "beta_q1n", Phylogenetic = "beta_q1p")
disp_lab <- c(Cold_control = "CC", Cold_intervention = "CI", Warm_control = "WC")
disp_run <- function(comparison, keep, grp) {
  map_dfr(names(disp_metrics), function(m) {
    M <- as.matrix(get(disp_metrics[[m]])$S)
    ids <- keep$Tube_code[keep$Tube_code %in% rownames(M)]
    d <- as.dist(M[ids, ids]); dat <- keep[match(labels(d), keep$Tube_code), ]
    set.seed(123)
    pt <- permutest(betadisper(d, factor(dat[[grp]])), pairwise = TRUE, permutations = 9999)
    pr <- pt$pairwise$permuted
    tibble(comparison = comparison, metric = m, n = nrow(dat),
           F = round(pt$tab[1, "F"], 2), p = round(pt$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"], 3),
           pairwise_p = if (length(pr) > 1) {
             nm <- names(pr); for (k in names(disp_lab)) nm <- gsub(k, disp_lab[[k]], nm, fixed = TRUE)
             paste(gsub("-", "\u2013", nm), sprintf("%.3f", pr), collapse = "; ")
           } else "")
  })
}
dispersion_fmt <- bind_rows(
  disp_run("FMT1: experimental groups", sample_metadata %>% filter(time_point == "FMT1"), "type"),
  disp_run("FMT2: experimental groups", sample_metadata %>% filter(time_point == "FMT2"), "type"),
  map_dfr(names(disp_lab), function(ty)
    disp_run(paste("Acclimation vs FMT1:", disp_lab[[ty]]),
             sample_metadata %>% filter(time_point %in% c("Acclimation", "FMT1"), type == ty), "time_point")))
dispersion_fmt %>% tt()
```

```{r paired_dispersion_acc_fmt1, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Within-group dispersion, Acclimation vs FMT1, PAIRED: per individual, difference in distance to the group centroid
# (betadisper distances, two time-point centroids) and Wilcoxon signed-rank test (exact when possible).
# Reported in Table S10 (supplementary_tables/table_S10_dispersion.R) instead of the free permutest above (which permutes repeated observations as independent).
paired_dispersion <- map_dfr(names(disp_lab), function(ty) map_dfr(names(disp_metrics), function(m) {
  keep <- sample_metadata %>% filter(time_point %in% c("Acclimation", "FMT1"), type == ty)
  M <- as.matrix(get(disp_metrics[[m]])$S)
  ids <- keep$Tube_code[keep$Tube_code %in% rownames(M)]
  d <- as.dist(M[ids, ids]); dat <- keep[match(labels(d), keep$Tube_code), ]
  bd <- betadisper(d, factor(dat$time_point))
  z <- tibble(ind = dat$individual, tp = dat$time_point, z = bd$distances) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = tp, values_from = z, values_fn = mean) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Acclimation), !is.na(FMT1))
  wt <- wilcox.test(z$Acclimation, z$FMT1, paired = TRUE)
  tibble(group = disp_lab[[ty]], metric = m, n_pairs = nrow(z), V = unname(wt$statistic), p = round(wt$p.value, 4))
}))
paired_dispersion %>% tt()
```

## Summary of functional trait counts cited in the manuscript

Wilcoxon rank-sum test per trait (traits with at least one non-zero value in the compared samples), Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted across traits, significant at adjusted p < 0.05. This reproduces the counts and trait codes cited in the Results (`n_significant` and `traits`); `higher_in` is the group (or time-point) with the higher mean trait value.

```{r functional_trait_counts_fmt, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
trait_test <- function(filter_expr, group_var) {
  element_gift %>%
    filter({{ filter_expr }}) %>%
    select(-time_point, -type) %>%
    filter(rowSums(across(where(is.numeric), ~ . != 0)) > 0) %>%
    select(Tube_code, where(~ is.numeric(.) && sum(.) > 0)) %>%
    left_join(sample_metadata %>% select(Tube_code, type, time_point), by = "Tube_code") %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(Tube_code, type, time_point), names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(trait) %>%
    summarise(p_value = wilcox.test(value ~ .data[[group_var]])$p.value,
              higher_in = names(which.max(tapply(value, .data[[group_var]], mean))), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    filter(p_adjust < 0.05) %>%
    left_join(uniqueGIFT_db, by = join_by("trait" == "Code_element"))
}
trait_sets <- list(
  "CC: Acclimation vs FMT1" = trait_test(time_point %in% c("Acclimation", "FMT1") & type == "Cold_control", "time_point"),
  "CI: Acclimation vs FMT1" = trait_test(time_point %in% c("Acclimation", "FMT1") & type == "Cold_intervention", "time_point"),
  "WC: Acclimation vs FMT1" = trait_test(time_point %in% c("Acclimation", "FMT1") & type == "Warm_control", "time_point"),
  "FMT1: CC vs CI" = trait_test(time_point == "FMT1" & type %in% c("Cold_control", "Cold_intervention"), "type"),
  "FMT1: CI vs WC" = trait_test(time_point == "FMT1" & type %in% c("Cold_intervention", "Warm_control"), "type"),
  "FMT1: CC vs WC" = trait_test(time_point == "FMT1" & type %in% c("Cold_control", "Warm_control"), "type"),
  "FMT2: CC vs CI" = trait_test(time_point == "FMT2" & type %in% c("Cold_control", "Cold_intervention"), "type"),
  "FMT2: CI vs WC" = trait_test(time_point == "FMT2" & type %in% c("Cold_intervention", "Warm_control"), "type"),
  "FMT2: CC vs WC" = trait_test(time_point == "FMT2" & type %in% c("Cold_control", "Warm_control"), "type"))
tibble(comparison = names(trait_sets),
       n_significant = map_int(trait_sets, nrow),
       traits = map_chr(trait_sets, ~ paste(.x$trait, collapse = ", "))) %>%
  tt()
```

```{r functional_trait_lists_fmt, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
trait_sets %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "comparison") %>%
  select(comparison, trait, higher_in, p_value, p_adjust, everything()) %>%
  tt()
```

***Metabolic capacity index (MCI) at FMT1, warm-control vs cold-intervention only***

The three-group ANOVA at FMT1 is given in the chunk `gitfs_functional_tm5_stats_2`; the manuscript reports the comparison between warm-control and cold-intervention.

```{r mci_fmt1_ci_wc, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
mci_fmt <- GIFTs_functions_community %>%
  rowMeans() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code)) %>%
  filter(time_point == "FMT1")
summary(aov(value ~ type, data = mci_fmt))
summary(aov(value ~ type, data = mci_fmt %>% filter(type %in% c("Warm_control", "Cold_intervention"))))
t.test(value ~ type, data = mci_fmt %>% filter(type %in% c("Warm_control", "Cold_intervention")), var.equal = TRUE)
```
